ingredients.name: chondrus crispus (aka irish moss or carageenan moss)
Niacinamide
ingredients.benefits: May support the skin barrier; reduce water loss; improve uneven tone; reduce redness; support acne-prone skin
ingredients.risks: Burning; flushing; irritation at high concentrations
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Generally no specific topical concern; medical review for therapeutic use
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not claim to cure acne or pigmentation

ingredients.name: Azelaic Acid
ingredients.benefits: May improve acne lesions, rosacea-related erythema, and hyperpigmentation
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Usually considered compatible with topical use; seek professional advice during pregnancy for medical-strength products
ingredients.professionalWarning: Persistent redness or pigmentation requires diagnosis

ingredients.name: Retinol
ingredients.benefits: May improve fine lines, uneven texture, acne, and uneven pigmentation
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Avoid during pregnancy unless specifically advised by a clinician
ingredients.comedogenicityNote: Product-specific; do not infer from ingredient alone
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not present cosmetic retinol as equivalent to prescription tretinoin

ingredients.name: Tretinoin
ingredients.benefits: Effective for acne and photoageing under medical supervision
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Avoid during pregnancy unless specifically directed by a clinician
ingredients.comedogenicityNote: Not applicable as a general cosmetic rating
ingredients.professionalWarning: Prescription medicine; must not be treated as an ordinary cosmetic ingredient

ingredients.name: Adapalene
ingredients.benefits: Improves acne, especially comedonal and inflammatory acne
ingredients.comedogenicityNote: Not applicable as a general cosmetic rating
ingredients.professionalWarning: Regulatory status varies by country

ingredients.name: Benzoyl Peroxide
ingredients.benefits: Reduces inflammatory acne lesions and acne-associated bacteria
ingredients.risks: Dryness; peeling; burning; redness; bleaching of fabrics
ingredients.photosensitivity: Possible irritation but not classic photosensitiser
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Medical advice may be appropriate during pregnancy or breastfeeding
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not use on severely irritated or broken skin

ingredients.name: Salicylic Acid
ingredients.benefits: Helps loosen scale and reduce clogged pores and acne lesions
ingredients.photosensitivity: May increase irritation; high-area exposure requires caution
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Seek professional advice during pregnancy, childhood, or extensive use
ingredients.professionalWarning: High-strength peels require professional handling

ingredients.name: Glycolic Acid
ingredients.benefits: May improve surface texture, dullness, uneven pigmentation, and fine lines
ingredients.risks: Stinging; burning; redness; peeling; barrier irritation
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Use professional advice for high-strength products during pregnancy
ingredients.professionalWarning: Concentration and pH are essential fields for risk scoring

ingredients.name: Lactic Acid
ingredients.benefits: May improve dryness, dullness, rough texture, and uneven pigmentation
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not describe all lactic-acid products as gentle

ingredients.name: Mandelic Acid
ingredients.benefits: May improve uneven texture and acne-prone skin
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Insufficient evidence for special pregnancy claims; seek professional advice
ingredients.professionalWarning: Evidence is less extensive than for glycolic acid

ingredients.name: Gluconolactone
ingredients.benefits: May improve hydration and mild roughness with potentially better tolerability than stronger acids
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not guarantee that PHAs cannot irritate

ingredients.name: L-Ascorbic Acid
ingredients.benefits: May support photoprotection, improve uneven tone, and reduce the appearance of fine lines
ingredients.risks: Stinging; dryness; irritation; oxidation-related product instability
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Insufficient evidence for a universal pregnancy warning
ingredients.professionalWarning: Formulation pH, packaging, and stability must be recorded

ingredients.name: Tocopherol
ingredients.benefits: May support skin conditioning and protect oils from oxidation
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not claim it provides sunscreen-level protection

ingredients.name: Hyaluronic Acid
ingredients.benefits: Temporarily improves skin hydration and surface plumpness
ingredients.risks: Occasional irritation; tight feeling in some formulas
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not claim that molecular weight predicts all clinical effects

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.benefits: Improves stratum-corneum hydration and reduces roughness
ingredients.comedogenicityNote: Generally low concern; complete formula matters
ingredients.professionalWarning: Primarily a moisturising ingredient, not a treatment for disease

ingredients.name: Urea
ingredients.benefits: Improves dry skin, roughness, and hyperkeratotic areas
ingredients.risks: Stinging on cracked or inflamed skin; irritation
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Medical advice for extensive or severe skin disease
ingredients.professionalWarning: Distinguish moisturising from keratolytic concentrations

ingredients.name: Panthenol
ingredients.benefits: May improve hydration and support recovery from irritation
ingredients.professionalWarning: Avoid claiming treatment of dermatitis without clinical evidence

ingredients.name: Ceramides
ingredients.benefits: Supports barrier function and reduces dryness when used in a suitable lipid formulation
ingredients.professionalWarning: Benefit depends on the complete formulation and lipid balance

ingredients.name: Cholesterol
ingredients.benefits: May support barrier repair when combined with ceramides and fatty acids
ingredients.professionalWarning: Presence alone does not prove clinical efficacy

ingredients.name: Squalane
ingredients.benefits: Reduces roughness and improves the feel of dry skin
ingredients.comedogenicityNote: Do not assign a universal comedogenic score
ingredients.professionalWarning: The source and stability of the oil should be recorded

ingredients.name: Petrolatum
ingredients.benefits: Protects and moisturises very dry or chapped skin
ingredients.risks: Greasy feel; folliculitis in some individuals
ingredients.comedogenicityNote: Not inherently comedogenic for every user; product formula matters
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not call it universally non-comedogenic

ingredients.name: Dimethicone
ingredients.benefits: Smooths and protects dry or irritated skin
ingredients.professionalWarning: A sensory film is not the same as pore blockage

ingredients.name: Colloidal Oatmeal
ingredients.benefits: May reduce dryness, itch, and irritation in suitable formulations
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Seek advice for known oat allergy
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not claim to treat eczema independently

ingredients.name: Allantoin
ingredients.benefits: May reduce the sensation of irritation and improve product tolerability
ingredients.professionalWarning: Evidence for major therapeutic effects is limited

ingredients.name: Green Tea Extract
ingredients.benefits: May support calming and antioxidant skincare
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not equate laboratory antioxidant activity with proven clinical treatment

ingredients.name: Licorice Extract
ingredients.benefits: May support the appearance of uneven tone and redness
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not generalise results across all licorice extracts

ingredients.name: Kojic Acid
ingredients.benefits: May improve some forms of hyperpigmentation
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Use professional advice for high-strength or prolonged use
ingredients.professionalWarning: Persistent or changing pigmentation requires assessment

ingredients.name: Tranexamic Acid
ingredients.benefits: May improve melasma and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Medical review may be needed for oral or systemic use; topical evidence differs
ingredients.professionalWarning: Topical and oral tranexamic acid must be clearly separated

ingredients.name: Alpha-Arbutin
ingredients.benefits: May reduce the appearance of uneven pigmentation
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not treat cosmetic arbutin as equivalent to hydroquinone

ingredients.name: Hydroquinone
ingredients.benefits: Can improve selected pigment disorders under professional supervision
ingredients.risks: Irritation; dermatitis; rare ochronosis with inappropriate prolonged use
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Medical supervision recommended; regulatory status varies
ingredients.comedogenicityNote: Not applicable as a general cosmetic rating
ingredients.professionalWarning: Must be jurisdiction-checked and separated from ordinary cosmetic ingredients

ingredients.name: Zinc Oxide
ingredients.benefits: Helps prevent sunburn and photoageing when correctly formulated and applied
ingredients.comedogenicityNote: Product formulation determines feel and acne suitability
ingredients.professionalWarning: Do not display SPF based only on ingredient presence

ingredients.name: Titanium Dioxide
ingredients.benefits: Contributes to sunscreen protection when used in an approved formula
ingredients.professionalWarning: Ingredient presence alone does not establish SPF or UVA protection

ingredients.name: Fragrance
ingredients.benefits: Improves sensory experience only
ingredients.risks: Irritation; allergic contact dermatitis; photoallergy for some components
ingredients.pregnancyNote: No general pregnancy claim; avoid if sensitive
ingredients.professionalWarning: List fragrance allergens separately where required

ingredients.name: Limonene
ingredients.benefits: No necessary skincare benefit
ingredients.photosensitivity: Possible photoirritation depending on formulation and oxidation
ingredients.professionalWarning: Must be distinguished from lemon extract or citrus oil

ingredients.name: Linalool
ingredients.benefits: No necessary skincare benefit
ingredients.professionalWarning: Oxidised linalool may have greater sensitisation risk

ingredients.name: Essential Oils
ingredients.benefits: Some laboratory antimicrobial or antioxidant activity, but clinical benefits vary substantially
ingredients.risks: Irritation; allergic contact dermatitis; phototoxicity for some oils
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Insufficient evidence for blanket pregnancy claims
ingredients.professionalWarning: Natural origin does not establish safety or efficacy

ingredients.name: Phenoxyethanol
ingredients.benefits: No direct skincare benefit; protects product safety
ingredients.professionalWarning: Preservative safety is concentration- and jurisdiction-dependent

ingredients.name: Methylisothiazolinone
ingredients.benefits: No direct skincare benefit; protects product safety
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Avoid in sensitised individuals; follow local regulation
ingredients.professionalWarning: Regulatory status varies and must be jurisdiction-specific

ingredients.name: Methylchloroisothiazolinone
ingredients.benefits: No direct skincare benefit; protects product safety
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Avoid in sensitised individuals; follow local regulation
ingredients.professionalWarning: Must be evaluated with methylisothiazolinone and product type

ingredients.name: Alcohol Denat.
ingredients.benefits: Can improve texture and drying feel; not itself a moisturising active
ingredients.photosensitivity: May increase irritation but not a classic photosensitiser
ingredients.professionalWarning: Distinguish ethanol from fatty alcohols such as cetyl alcohol

ingredients.name: Cetyl Alcohol
ingredients.benefits: Softens skin and improves formula texture
ingredients.professionalWarning: Fatty alcohols are chemically different from drying alcohols

ingredients.name: Stearyl Alcohol
ingredients.benefits: Softens and conditions skin
ingredients.professionalWarning: Primarily a formulation ingredient

ingredients.name: Silicones
ingredients.benefits: Smooths skin and hair; may reduce water loss depending on the silicone
ingredients.professionalWarning: Different silicones have different volatility and functions

ingredients.name: Sulfur
ingredients.benefits: May improve acne and some scaling conditions
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Seek professional advice for extensive use or special populations
ingredients.professionalWarning: Evidence and use depend on concentration and product type

ingredients.name: Tea Tree Oil
ingredients.benefits: May provide limited support for acne in some formulations
ingredients.risks: Irritation; allergic contact dermatitis; toxicity if ingested
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Avoid ingestion; use professional advice for children and pregnancy
ingredients.professionalWarning: Clinical evidence is limited and sensitisation is possible

ingredients.name: Peptides
ingredients.benefits: May improve the appearance of fine lines, but results vary by peptide and formulation
ingredients.professionalWarning: Evidence must be linked to the specific peptide and formulation

ingredients.name: Hydroquinone Monobenzyl Ether
ingredients.benefits: Used only for specific medical indications, not routine cosmetic brightening
ingredients.professionalWarning: High-risk medical ingredient; jurisdiction-specific handling required

ingredients.name: Topical Corticosteroids
ingredients.benefits: May reduce inflammatory dermatitis when correctly prescribed
ingredients.risks: Skin thinning; telangiectasia; acneiform eruption; rebound; infection risk
ingredients.pregnancyNote: Medical supervision and potency-specific advice required
ingredients.professionalWarning: Never classify as an ordinary cosmetic active
